name: meta-ads-agent
description: Agent-native Meta (Facebook/Instagram) Ads toolkit built on Meta's official Ads MCP, with a narrow Marketing API fallback for the few capabilities that server does not expose.

plugins.name: meta-ads-agent
plugins.description: Audit a Meta ad account, plan and build campaigns paused-by-default, preview every placement before launch, report on equal-length periods, and diagnose before changing anything. Twelve skills, a validated campaign plan, resumable state, and an approval gate on anything that spends.
